856-2292-4321-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2292-4321-8347.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1432-1557-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ioreth of the Healing House is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1432-1557-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1432-1557-4613.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

3755-4460-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3752-7666-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
3752-7666-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Burglar's Plot.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

465-585-1753-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1479-2841-6528-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6528-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2034-2415-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-7818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3129-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Primal Vigor
Repeat.

877-3081-3817-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1368-1563-6321-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-6965.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2554-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Third Path Iconoclast
1618-2440-2554-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Third Path Iconoclast triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2554-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Third Path Iconoclast. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

240-413-969-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1492-7296.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-7296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

215-4010-6723-7297.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-6723-7297.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1409-2499-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve both Plundering Pirate triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

372-4681-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3129-4571-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-4571-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Life // Death
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1545-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1545-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2416-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-2416-5527.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Rise and Shine.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-4067-6281-6927.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Damage Control Crew.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Damage Control Crew that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

132-2645-5139.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Relic of Sauron's ability by tapping it, adding two in any combination of {U}, {B} and/or {R}.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-5139.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

1856-4050-5544-6822.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and Forsaken Miner.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

215-546-2544-6788.description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {1} and causing the next artifact spell you cast to gain sunburst.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Solar Array.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ramos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ramos by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Solar Array triggers, giving Ramos sunburst, which will cause it to enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters.
Repeat.

1636-4183-4891.description:
Activate Saheeli, the Sun's Brilliance by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Atsushi.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Atsushi and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.
1636-4183-4891.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can target other artifacts or creatures. You can also choose Atsushi's other mode.

972-2084.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
972-2084.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1753-2034-3372-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1753-2034-3372-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1809-2254-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value zero.
1809-2254-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying zero {E}, sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Returned Pastcaller's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Returned Pastcaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-2292-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-2292-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2292-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

4499-4659-5868.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Frost Fair Lure Fish.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens and two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Treasures.

152-4155-4600.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of The Stasis Coffin.
Activate the Stasis Coffin token by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

1322-1409-2691.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Ilysian Caryatid.
1322-1409-2691.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ilysian Caryatid enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.

413-2043-3621.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1367-1702-3212.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Nexus of Fate on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Nexus of Fate, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

2520-3179-3676-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Activate Skyshroud Elf by paying {G}, adding {W}.
Repeat.
